title: Inland Vessels - Dredgers - Floaters
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard lays down the requirements for floaters for dredgers used mainly for float pipes of dredger's delivery piping system.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
Internal Combustion Engines - Methods of Test for Quality Characteristics of Valves

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
